verdict.rationale: Cache and model-file reuse across runtimes is a fair question for an on-device inference SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence covers download progress and download events only, plus a fallback to llama.cpp on M1/M2. Nothing documents whether downloaded model files or caches can be shared with other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them
